_readme: Config for scripts/grade-frames.mjs. Copy it, keep the copy and the original photographs OUTSIDE the repository, then run:
node scripts/grade-frames.mjs --config <this file> --src <folder with the originals> [--only f01,f02] [--dry-run]
frames[]            one entry per original photograph. Keys that start with an underscore are ignored.
id                short name of the frame: letters, digits, '-' and '_'. It is the default output file name
and the id used in src/data/frames.ts.
file              the original, relative to --src. JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or TIFF (export HEIC as JPEG first).
outputs[]         what to make from it. Each output is graded the same way and written without any metadata.
kind 'scope'    a 2.39:1 cinema frame  -> src/assets/frames/<name or id>.jpg, at most 2560 px wide.
crop          { x, y, w } as fractions (0..1) of the upright picture: x, y = top-left corner, w = width.
The height follows from 2.39:1. Left out: x and y centre the crop, w is the full width.
A crop that runs past the edge is moved back inside. A crop narrower than 1477 px
(1920 / 1.3) is an error, unless the whole original is that small: then it is a warning.
kind 'still'    the whole picture       -> src/assets/stills/<name or id>.jpg, at most 2200 px on the long side.
crop          optional { x, y, w, h } as fractions of the upright picture.
name            optional file name for this output (default: the frame id). Two outputs may not share a file.
exposure          optional, in stops: 0.3 opens a dark picture, -0.3 calms a bright one. White stays ivory. Default 0.
warmth            optional, -1..1: above 0 warmer (0.2 is a clear step), below 0 takes warmth out. The look keeps
cool colours grey, so a picture never turns blue. Default 0.
strength          optional, 0..1: how much of the look is applied. 1 = the full grade, 0 = the corrected original
printed between ink and ivory. Default 1.
rotate            optional, degrees clockwise, applied after the EXIF orientation. 90 / 180 / 270 turn the picture;
a small angle (for example -1.5) straightens a horizon, and the picture is then trimmed to the
largest clean rectangle of the same proportions. Crops are fractions of the result. Default 0.
Nothing is ever upscaled, and nothing is written outside src/assets/frames and src/assets/stills.
The look itself (one grade for every picture) lives in scripts/grade.mjs.

frames._note: a portrait original: the frame is a band across it, the still is the upper two thirds
